Finding 3 states that deleteWithdrawMessage resets startTime but leaves withdrawMsgIdProcessed set, so a cancelled id can't be authorized again.
No report finding covers the inconsistent handling of a zero feeReceiver.
No report finding covers claimWithdrawal updating state after the external call (CEI/reentrancy ordering).
Finding 8 is about unused roles in Upgrader0to1. It does not cover Treasury's unused StorageV1 or the role constants in Treasury.sol, so it is a different location.
Finding 2 states that _authorizeWithdraw never checks withdrawMsgIdProcessed, so the same withdrawId can be reused in a different message.
